# Getting help

- **Documentation**: <https://rungeass.com/docs/>. [Troubleshooting](https://rungeass.com/docs/operations/troubleshooting/) lists
  what to check for the installer, the dashboard, nodes and services, and [Install Geass](https://rungeass.com/docs/getting-started/install/)
  says what the installer does and leaves undone.
- **A bug**: [open an issue](https://github.com/degoke/geass/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with the release, your
  environment, and the installer or operator log (without secrets).
- **An idea**: [open a feature request](https://github.com/degoke/geass/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem**: do not open an issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Geass is software you run yourself, and its maintainers cannot log in to your servers. Issues are answered as time allows,
with no guarantee of response time. If you need a guaranteed response, that is not something the project offers.
